completed.task: Redis Session 5 — Distributed Semaphore. Replace per-worker asyncio.Semaphore with Redis Sorted Set semaphore. Atomic Lua acquire script (ZREMRANGEBYSCORE+ZCARD+ZADD). pipeline_semaphore(task_id) method on TaskStoreProtocol/DbTaskStore/TaskStore. 14 runner call sites updated. Self-healing 2h member TTL. Graceful fallback to asyncio.Semaphore without Redis.

Redis Session 4 — Approval Queues. Replace asyncio.Queue with Redis LPUSH/BRPOP in DbTaskStore. Redis-first nonce validation (GET), duplicate prevention (SET NX), payload delivery (LPUSH/BRPOP via asyncio.to_thread). Nonce write/clear in update_task. Graceful fallback to asyncio.Queue when Redis unavailable.

Redis Session 3 — HITL RedisSaver. Shared core/checkpointer.py factory (lazy singleton with double-checked locking, graceful MemorySaver fallback). Replaced 5 duplicated _resolve_checkpointer() across graph modules (11 graph builders). Updated v1.0 pipeline to use get_checkpointer(). Config toggle: redis_checkpointer=True. 1 Codex finding (thread-safety race) resolved.
